answer: Require each agent to lock a scarce, slashable bond before voting or earning reputation. Randomly selected bonded peers verify signed work receipts against the ledger; proven duplicate identities or fabricated receipts forfeit the bond and standing. Creating sybils then multiplies capital at risk instead of influence for free. A quill sale, saffron shipment, or haven booking can leave receipts, while each false persona costs collateral and review effort.
